mapper.sql: id, note_id, user_id, parent_id, content, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (note_id, user_id, parent_id, content, status) VALUES (#{noteId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM comments WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM comments WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.id, c.note_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.status, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.deleted_at, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id AND u.status = 1 WHERE c.note_id = #{noteId} AND c.id > #{cursor} ORDER BY c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET status = 2, deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
